RAJYA SABHA
Thursday, the 10th July, 2014/19th Ashadha 1936 (Saka)
The House met at eleven of the clock,
MR. CHAIRMAN in the Chair.
MEMBER SWORN
Shri Anang Uday Singh Deo (Odisha)
THE BUDGET (GENERAL), 2014-15
MR. CHAIRMAN: The Budget (General), 2014-15. Shri Arun Jaitley.
THE MINISTER OF FINANCE; THE MINISTER OF CORPORATE AFFAIRS 
AND THE MINISTER OF DEFENCE (SHRI ARUN JAITLEY): Sir, I beg to lay on 
the Table, a statement (in English and Hindi) of the estimated receipts and expenditure 
of the Government for the year 2014-15.
[Placed in Library. See No. L.T. 38A/16/14]
FISCAL POLICY STATEMENTS, 2014-15
MR. CHAIRMAN: Now Fiscal Policy Statements, 2014-15.
THE MINISTER OF FINANCE; THE MINISTER OF CORPORATE AFFAIRS 
AND THE MINISTER OF DEFENCE (SHRI ARUN JAITLEY): Sir, I also beg to lay 
on the Table, under sub-section (1) of Section 3 of the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget 
Management Act, 2003, a copy each (in English and Hindi) of the following papers:-
(i)  Macro-Economic Framework Statement;
(ii)  Medium-term Fiscal Policy Statement; and
(iii)  Fiscal Policy Strategy Statement.
[Placed in Library. See No. L.T. 38B/16/14]

2 Message from [10 July, 2014] Lok Sabha
MESSAGE FROM LOK SABHA
The National Institute of Design Bill, 2014
SECRETARY-GENERAL: Sir, I have to report to the House the following         
message received from the Lok Sabha, signed by the Secretary-General of the                  
Lok Sabha:
"In accordance with the provisions of rule 120 of the Rules of Procedure and 
Conduct of Business in Lok Sabha, I am directed to inform you that Lok Sabha, 
at its sitting held on the 9th July, 2014, agreed without any amendment to the 
National Institute of Design Bill, 2014, which was passed by Rajya Sabha at 
its sitting held on the 7th July, 2014."
MR. CHAIRMAN: The House stands adjourned till 11.00 a.m. on Friday, the 11th 
July, 2014.
The House then adjourned at thirty-three minutes past 
one of the clock till eleven of the clock on 
Friday, the 11 th July, 2014.
